query:
INSERT INTO dealers (userId, name, subscriptionStatus, subscriptionExpiresAt, isVerified, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT u.id, 'EVEEVO Admin Dealer', 'active', DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), true, NOW(), NOW()
FROM users u
WHERE u.email = 'anthony.m.perry@gmail.com'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dealers d WHERE d.userId = u.id);
